Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being rceorded for the claim file. Can you confirm
that you're comfortable with that?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Great. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in a parking lot in Houston, Texas, at a shopping center. I had just pulled into a space near the main
entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was backing out of the space, slowly. I had checked my mirrors and didn't see anything coming.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle came down the aisle from my right side. It wasn't going fast, but it clipped the rear quarter panel of my
car. I felt a jolt and heard a loud bang.
Q: Did you stop after the contact?
A: Yes, I stopped right away and put the car in park.
Q: Did the other driver stop as well?
A: They did. The driver got out and we talked briefly. They said they were sorry and that they hadn't seen my car.
Q: Were you hurt in the collision?
A: Yes. I felt a sharp pain in my right shoulder when the impact pushed me against the seatbelt. It's been sore sicne
then, and I've had trouble lifting my arm above my head.
Q: Have you sought medical attention?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with my regular
doctor.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'm just hopnig to get my car repaired and get my shoulder looked after.
Q: Thank you for your time today. We'll be in touch with next steps.
A: Thank you.
